title: aftersales.request_rejected, version 1
description: No refund was agreed: the merchant rejected the request (action MERCHANT_REJECT, with the merchant's reason in merchant_note) or the customer declined the counter-offer (action CUSTOMER_DECLINE_OFFER). The customer may ask the platform to step in until deadline_at. Topic after-sales-events, record key: the order id, aggregate: AFTER_SALES_CASE (aggregate_id = the case id).
